scientific_limitations: Exact Theis linear superposition; unbounded uniform confined aquifer and indefinitely operated constant-rate point wells; no noise, boundaries, leakage, wellbore storage or field validation. Historical papers from 1935 and 1985 have publicly verified month/year but no verified first-publication day in the inspected evidence; day-resolved literature anchor is Weber and Chapuis first online 2013-01-03.
title: Sharp reentrant drawdown reversals from delayed pumping and injection wells
